notes: Luxaire does NOT use usesStylesOf york: it has extra numeric and 2-letter styles, and its style-1 month table conflicts with York's for September-December (see style-1 notes). SHIPPED IN PHASE 2b: style-4 (4 letters + 6-digit sequence, sample WAKM011379 = January 1980 or 2001) via the dual-candidate schema extension; now IMAGE-CONFIRMED (image-pass Nov 8, see style-4 notes). Style-1 (10-character serials, sample W0K5896070 = October 2005) is chart-verified and shipped (image-pass Nov 8) from Luxaire's own chart: the K-month conflict is real, chart-vs-chart -- Luxaire's chart maps K to October while York's and Coleman's map the same serial's K to September; each brand file follows its own chart, and Luxaire's table is not overwritten with York's. Style-4's month table (K September) and style-1's table (K October) are two different systems' tables, not one contradiction. Style-5 (2 letters + 6-digit sequence, sample HM409295 = August 1982 or 2003) is chart-verified and shipped (image-pass Nov 8); its tables are identical to style-4's, as the chart itself shows. Style-6 (11-digit numeric, year/month stated Unknown on the page) is intentionally omitted: no year can be extracted from it, and the page only gives a 1965-1981 company-name window and a contact-the-manufacturer instruction. Luxaire page last updated 2016, older than the York (2024) and Coleman (2023) pages.

styles.notes: Chart-verified (image-pass Nov 8): 2nd and 4th digits combine for the year ('0'+'5'='05' = 2005), 3rd character is the month letter. Luxaire's own chart maps K to October (J September, L November, M December, no N) -- a genuine chart-vs-chart conflict with York/Coleman, which map the same sample serial's K to September; each brand file follows its own chart. yearFloor 2004 is per the York chart's October 2004 start (the Luxaire page states no era); cited, not assumed from Luxaire text.
